design: New post-lock adjudication protocol; not a replacement for historical preregistration.

assessor_provenance.role: independent of original map authors and finalisation engineering; current curator
knowledge_before_commit: User mission exposes arm/author mapping, edit counts and historical verdicts.
Recovery README and prior D1/D2 comparison read.
PR125 body and curator comment read.
No source PNGs inspected for this new assessment before rubric commit.
assessor_provenance.independence_limits: Reviewers share an inherited mission and model family. Independent execution is not independent training, authorship ignorance, or multiple human assessors.

scale.0: Absent, incoherent or harmful for the intended architectural role.
scale.1: Weak or ambiguous; important relationship is missing.
scale.2: Coherent and legible with material limitations.
scale.3: Strong, distinctive and supported by source geometry.
scale.4: Exceptional exemplar for the specified relation; no material unresolved concern in this criterion.
scale.null: Not assessable from supplied evidence; never substitute zero.

criteria.label: Support grammar and apparent structural causality
Usefulness and quality of negative space
Traversal affordance clarity at Midge scale
Preservation of unusual or damaged features
Avoidance of homogenisation and generic filler
Exemplar usefulness for future rule derivation
Distinction between actual function and visual suggestion

scoring.unit: Ordinal 0..4 scores with criterion-specific evidence; half-points prohibited.
scoring.summary: Sum(weight*score/4) over assessable criteria, divided by assessed weight then multiplied by 100. Always publish assessed weight and unscored criteria.
scoring.comparison: Compute paired weighted score difference using only criteria assessed on all compared variants. A score is an auditable judgement, not a calibrated measurement or statistical effect estimate.
confidence: low: partial evidence or subjective ambiguity
scoring.candidate_rule: Recommend an architectural uplift candidate only if paired weighted difference >=5 points, at least one predeclared target criterion rises >=1, and no confirmed preservation, source-integrity or material native regression. This is a decision aid, not owner Platinum acceptance.
scoring.inconclusive_rule: If intended gain requires speed, physics or player decisions not executed, mark that intended gain inconclusive regardless of static score.
scoring.no_change_rule: Identical material planes/nongeometry and justified protected spatial logic are positive restraint controls; do not score them as failed authoring.
scoring.regression_rule: Any confirmed loss of protected geometry/negative space, misleading functional claim, lost required route or new severe obstruction is a veto until scoped and resolved. Never rescue a locked candidate by editing it.

presentation.views: Full world overview plus identical-coordinate native-resolution crops per arm. Uniform material palette/coordinate frame. No crop is an edit mask.
presentation.randomisation: One reproducible seed; independent permutation per arm; labels A/B/C only. Commit answer-key digest before viewing randomized images. Keep exact source identities in separate key.
presentation.prohibited: No image generation, beautification, arbitrary recropping to favour an arm, density-as-quality scoring, reconstructed-original substitution or hidden skipped comparison.
presentation.controls: Include all three duplicate no-change pairs; disclose identical pairs only after scoring where a genuinely uninformed assessor is available.
presentation.blinding: This team's scores remain unblinded because the mission exposes author mapping. Anonymized images support a later unfamiliar assessor; their production does not establish a blind study.

gold_policy.owner_acceptance: pending for every map unless explicit exact-source owner acceptance appears.
gold_policy.native: Native evidence must name source, engine, execution and scope; all-map/static evidence cannot stand in for native qualification.
gold_policy.conditional_125: A new exact-source specialist visual assessment may close the historical Art-evidence gap, but cannot supply missing Technical/native/owner gates by declaration.
gold_policy.selection: Assess unique relational teaching value and nearest neighbours. A numeric 25 target never overrides evidence gaps. Keep frozen Gold25 separate from versioned recommendation.
gold_policy.unknown: Missing metadata remains unknown, never absent/failed.
